examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A composed platform screen filling the container at the default 800-pixel height. Drag the right edge to change the width, the bottom edge to change the height, or the corner to change both, and watch the grid, the header and the closing band reflow.

examples.name: Breakpoints
examples.summary: The same screen pinned to mobile (375 × 812), tablet (768 × 1024) and desktop (1280 × 800). Mobile and tablet sit side by side on wide canvases and wrap below on narrow ones; the desktop frame takes its own row. Each viewport resolves its own breakpoints and scrolls its content inside, and a frame wider than its column is scaled down to fit instead of clamped.

examples.name: LongAddress
examples.summary: A long address in a narrow column. The leading part ellipsizes and the last 12 characters always stay visible.
